correctness.rationale: The kernel stabilizer of a B-linear leakage map is a subfield. Coefficients in the common stabilizer descend to linear maps on leaked values, so leakage from every computed block factors through the input-block leakage. Nonzero one-symbol trace leakage has stabilizer exactly B by nondegeneracy of the trace pairing. In the cited rank criterion, identical leakage and a B-valued computation matrix give exact Kronecker rank factorization, reducing the product criterion to K copies of the base criterion.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 17 September 2026 motivating preprint proves the identical-leakage obstruction only for simple addition, suggests array summation, and gives simulations for more general coefficients. It does not state the stabilizer-field theorem or the all-base-field-computation rank factorization. Targeted external and SCOPE searches found no prior statement; the very recent source creates a material near-simultaneous-discovery risk.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp reusable boundary for identical leakage: all computations over the leakage-stabilizer field add zero leakage information. For trace leakage the boundary is exactly the base field, proving the suggested array-summation case and covering arbitrary base-field linear circuits while explaining why extension-field coefficients evade the obstruction.
